request: Does the sofa colour go with the floor? Explain the visible palette and one optional small improvement. Do not change anything.

reply.message:
The sofa’s muted sage green suits the supplied palette: sandy beige rug, warm cream walls, brown wood tones and terracotta seating create a balanced, earthy combination. However, no room image or floor finish is supplied, so I can’t confirm the sofa–floor match itself.

One optional small improvement: a slightly warmer cream rug colour could soften the contrast around the sofa. Nothing has been changed.
